pass10_context: P10-U4 adds one bounded owner-refresh adapter between the read-only projection and Bank tab. Only an exact accepted Bank-owner receipt present in the owner boundary refreshes the projection once. Wrong-owner, duplicate, stale, malformed, Helper, active-tab, and direct UI events fail closed. The adapter and tab expose no write, delete, migration, raw-payload, timer, or retry surface.
rule: The root trust anchor cannot verify its own pre-execution bytes; it carries the exact digest for the deterministic protected runtime source set.
